authority: Operator instruction (in-session): build the final_export_writer deterministic component to close the n08f gap found in run 5952b165. Logged per §9.4. Component addition under §17.5.3 (C2) with manifest binding per §16.5 (C3); no gate logic, artifact schema, or skill semantics altered.

problem.symptom: Run 5952b165 (the first run to reach n08f_revision) failed with failure_origin='agent_body', failure_category='INCOMPLETE_OUTPUT': all four n08f skills succeeded but the §17.6.6 disk check found docs/tier5_deliverables/final_exports/ empty.
problem.root_cause: final_export.json was schema-bound (orch.tier5.final_export.v1, artifact_schema_specification.yaml §2.3), gate-checked (gate_12 predicates g11_p05 non_empty_json + g11_p05b artifact_owned_by_run), listed in the artifact registry as produced_by n08f_revision, and named as the revision integrator's primary canonical output — but NO producer existed: no skill in the catalog writes it, no deterministic component was bound, and runner/docx_exporter.py writes only the .docx (which would not satisfy the .json disk check). n08f could therefore never satisfy can_evaluate_exit_gate. This was the known DOD-1e scope-honest residual (dod-1e-n08f-checkpoint-published_2026-07-28.json closed only the checkpoint-publish half of n08f).

decision.component: runner/final_export_writer.py (new), registered as 'final_export_writer' in runner/deterministic_components.py COMPONENT_REGISTRY, bound in manifest.compile.yaml n08f_revision deterministic_components.
decision.behaviour: Reads the n08d assembled draft (part_b_assembled_draft.json). Fails closed on: missing/malformed/empty/wrong-schema draft, a draft owned by a different run (assembly has no cross-run reuse), an empty/duplicate/malformed section list, or a referenced section artifact absent or invalid. Writes (1) final_exports/part_b_json_bundle.json — the exported proposal: the assembled draft plus every referenced section artifact embedded VERBATIM, self-contained because final_exports/ is terminal (consumed_by: []); then (2) final_exports/final_export.json — the schema-bound manifest: export_format 'json_bundle', export_path naming the bundle, section_index sorted by the draft's explicit order field with criterion supplying section_name, exported_at stamp. Manifest written after the bundle so it can never point at a missing export. artifact_status omitted at write time.
decision.determinism_class: Pure lookup + verbatim copy (§17.5.3). The bundle carries no stamp and is fully byte-equal replayable; the single non-deterministic manifest field is exported_at (production stamp, excluded from the replay invariant — the gate_result.evaluated_at / phase8_checkpoint.published_at precedent).
decision.overwrite_semantics: NOT write-once, deliberately unlike the checkpoint: g11_p05b requires the export to carry the CURRENT run's run_id, so every run reaching n08f rewrites the export deterministically from its own assembled draft.
decision.binding_order: ['final_export_writer', 'checkpoint_publisher'] — the export writer is bound FIRST because it is idempotent-overwrite while the checkpoint publisher is write-once: publishing the checkpoint last ensures a failed export can never strand a freshly published checkpoint that would block re-publication on rerun.

operational_action.why: The checkpoint publisher's write-once guard would otherwise block n08f on the next run (CheckpointPublishError before any skill executes). Precedent: commit c8a0819 archived the msca-pf-graph-01 checkpoint the same way before a fresh run. The archive preserves the durable evidence verbatim.
operational_action.side_effect: The three DOD-1e real-data oracle tests (tests/runner/test_dod1e_checkpoint_close.py), which pin the msca-pf-graph-01 checkpoint at the live path, had turned red when run 5952b165 published its own checkpoint there; after this archive they return to their designed skip state (fixture skips when the live path is absent). Whether to re-point that oracle at the archived msca-pf-graph-01 artifact is left to the operator — it is M2-T10 closure evidence, and its quad-verbatim assertion can no longer be checked against the moving tree (gate_09's durable result has since been re-evaluated under newer run ids).

explicitly_not_changed: orch.tier5.final_export.v1 schema — implemented as specified; no fields added or removed.
gate_12 predicates g11_p05/g11_p05b and the gate evaluator — the component does not evaluate gates (§17.6.2).

runner/docx_exporter.py — the operator-facing .docx export remains a separate CLI path; export_format 'docx' was not chosen because .docx serialization is not byte-equal replayable (zip timestamps), violating the §17.5.3 determinism closure.
Phase-8 reuse fingerprints — FINGERPRINT_INPUTS hashes tier directories and named skill/agent specs only; the manifest edit does not invalidate n08a/b/c reuse.
verification: py -3.10 -m pytest tests/runner/test_final_export_writer.py (24 new tests: happy path, schema conformance, order-sort, self-contained verbatim bundle, byte-equal replay, overwrite-per-run, 12 fail-closed paths, registry/adapter integration) — pass.
tests/runner/test_node_resolver.py updated: n08f now binds ['final_export_writer', 'checkpoint_publisher'] (order asserted).

Full affected sweep (node resolver, deterministic components, checkpoint publisher, phase8 reuse, scheduler, dispatch integration, phase8 integration/pipeline, manifest graph, gate scenarios, run context, runtime full-run) — pass; only the pre-existing dod1e state-drift reds resolved to skips by the checkpoint archive.

Real-data smoke over copies of run 5952b165's artifacts (scratchpad): 409KB self-contained bundle, schema-conformant manifest, section_index [excellence, impact, implementation], bundle byte-equal on replay.
